name: monthly-ops-analysis
description: Generate a fixed-structure monthly e-commerce operations analysis report from read-only MaxCompute SQL scripts via odps-query, with derived SQL self-registration and chart output.
descriptionZh: 月度经营分析：自学只读 SQL 脚本（目标达成/品类拆解/新老品），经 odps-query 取数，按固定大纲生成含图表的经营分析报告，派生查询自动固化复用。
